# Alan Dopp

> Alan Dopp of Idaho Falls, Idaho: husband, father of seven and grandfather. Health teacher at Thunder Ridge High School since 1997 and javelin coach. Idaho high school state record holder in the high jump (6 ft 10.75 in, 1989, South Fremont High School), the nation's top high school high jumper in 1990 (7 ft 0.5 in, featured by ESPN), Simplot Games record holder, All-American at Ricks College (1990-1993), Big Sky All-Conference decathlete, team captain and MVP at Idaho State University (1994-1996), and 2023 Huntsman World Senior Games high jump gold medalist. Also competes in the Idaho Senior Games and Scottish Highland Games heavy events.

## Projects
- doppsclass.com: a high school health course rebuilt as a quest game
- The Burland: a restored 1912 event hall in St. Anthony, Idaho (https://theburland.com/)
- Worst Song Ever: comedy songs and custom songs (https://worstsong.com/)
- The Circumpunct: a book in progress

## Work with Alan
- Gamified class websites and learning games for teachers and schools
- Speaking on family, parenting, character, comebacks and gamified teaching
- Custom songs
- Event and reunion space at The Burland
